crossRefs.note: to him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
to him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to…
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…

translations.web: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
translations.bsb: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
translations.kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
translations.asv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
